sentences.en: Last week, OpenAI was in the odd position of rooting for the success of its fiercest competitor’s IPO.
sentences.zh: 上週，OpenAI 處在一個奇怪的位置：還得為死對頭的 IPO 成功加油。

sentences.en: This week, the focus will turn to when OpenAI follows suit—or if market turbulence derails an offering for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 本週焦點將轉向 OpenAI 何時跟進——或者市場動盪是否會讓這次發行在可預見的未來都泡湯。

sentences.en: There have always been good reasons for OpenAI to move quickly.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 一直有充分的理由要盡快行動。

sentences.en: While IPO timing isn’t a big determinant of long-term business success, there are clear advantages in being a first mover.
sentences.zh: 雖然 IPO 時點並不是長期商業成功的重要決定因素，但身為先發者仍有明顯優勢。

sentences.en: Back in 2019, for instance, Lyft rushed to an IPO faster than its ride-sharing rival Uber.
sentences.zh: 例如 2019 年，Lyft 就比共乘對手 Uber 更早搶先上市。

sentences.en: But Lyft’s listing got off to a rocky start, which impacted the initial pricing of Uber’s shares.
sentences.zh: 但 Lyft 的上市開局不順，也影響了 Uber 股票的初次定價。

sentences.en: Uber ultimately fared much better than its rival—its market capitalization is about $130 billion, compared with about $6 billion for Lyft.
sentences.zh: Uber 最終表現遠優於對手：其市值約 1,300 億美元，Lyft 則約 60 億美元。

sentences.en: OpenAI, after all, has been bleeding executive talent this year.
sentences.zh: 畢竟，OpenAI 今年一直在流失高階人才。

sentences.en: Its financial condition doesn’t look stellar when compared with Anthropic’s, either.
sentences.zh: 和 Anthropic 相比，它的財務狀況看起來也不出色。

sentences.en: But Anthropic’s grew to $17 billion in the same period, while it reported a smaller operating loss than OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 但同期 Anthropic 的營收成長到 170 億美元，帳上的營業虧損也比 OpenAI 更小。

sentences.en: If OpenAI is able to gain a step on Anthropic in model development and take some of its market share in sales of AI tools to companies, its story becomes more compelling.
sentences.zh: 若 OpenAI 能在模型開發上超前 Anthropic 一步，並搶下一部分企業 AI 工具的市占率，它的故事就會更有說服力。

sentences.en: Despite all that, the reasons for OpenAI to move with some urgency are fairly overwhelming, given how much funding it wants to fuel its ambitions.
sentences.zh: 儘管如此，考量 OpenAI 為實現野心所需的資金規模，它必須加快腳步的理由已相當充分。

sentences.en: Jensen Huang made a Sam Altman-esque return on Monday, resuming his role as chief executive of Nvidia after an 11-day hiatus.
sentences.zh: 週一，黃仁勳以類似山姆・阿特曼的方式回歸，在暫停 11 天後重新擔任輝達執行長。

sentences.en: The stunning about-face by Nvidia’s board, which only last week said it wasn’t considering reappointing Huang, sent Nvidia’s shares skyrocketing in trading on Monday.
sentences.zh: 輝達董事會驚人的一百八十度轉變——上週才說沒有考慮重新任命黃仁勳——讓輝達股價在週一交易中飆升。

sentences.en: Yet Anthropic is unencumbered by the massive franchises tech companies have built up over the years—an edge that should make it quicker to adapt as AI technology changes.
sentences.zh: 然而 Anthropic 不受科技公司多年來累積的龐大既有事業拖累——這項優勢應能讓它在 AI 技術轉變時更快調整。

vocab.usage: one’s fiercest competitor / rival 最激烈的競爭對手；the fiercest debate 最激烈的辯論（fierce 的最高級）
vocab.example: The two airlines are fiercest rivals on the trans-Pacific route.
vocab.example_zh: 這兩家航空公司是跨太平洋航線上最激烈的對手。

vocab.usage: follows suit 跟進做同樣的事；if one firm cuts prices, others may follow suit 若一家公司降價，其他公司可能跟進
vocab.example: When the largest bank raised fees, several rivals followed suit.
vocab.example_zh: 當最大的銀行提高手續費後，好幾家對手也跟進。

vocab.usage: market turbulence 市場動盪；political turbulence 政治動盪；飛行時也指「亂流」
vocab.example: Market turbulence made investors more cautious.
vocab.example_zh: 市場動盪讓投資人變得更謹慎。

vocab.usage: derail an offering / a plan 打亂發行／計畫；the project was derailed 計畫受挫
vocab.example: A supply shortage could derail the product launch.
vocab.example_zh: 供應短缺可能會打亂這次產品上市。

vocab.usage: for the foreseeable future 在可預見的未來；no change in the foreseeable future 可預見的未來不會改變
vocab.example: Interest rates are likely to stay high for the foreseeable future.
vocab.example_zh: 在可預見的未來，利率很可能維持在高檔。

vocab.usage: a key / big determinant of success 成功的關鍵決定因素；the main determinant 主要決定因素
vocab.example: Location is a major determinant of housing prices.
vocab.example_zh: 地點是房價的主要決定因素。

vocab.zh: 先發者；率先進入市場者
vocab.usage: a first mover in the industry 產業中的先發者；first-mover advantage 先發優勢
vocab.example: Being a first mover can help a company set industry standards.
vocab.example_zh: 成為先發者，有助於公司制定產業標準。

vocab.usage: an IPO listing 首次上市掛牌；got off to a rocky start（上市）開局不順
vocab.example: The company’s listing attracted strong demand from institutions.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司的上市獲得了機構投資人的強勁需求。

vocab.usage: a rocky start / beginning 開局不順；a rocky relationship 關係坎坷
vocab.example: The merger got off to a rocky start after several executives resigned.
vocab.example_zh: 好幾位高階主管離職後，這樁合併開局並不順利。

vocab.usage: fare better / worse than 表現比…好／差；how did they fare? 他們表現如何？名詞 fare 則是「車資、票價」
vocab.example: Smaller shops fared worse during the downturn.
vocab.example_zh: 景氣下滑期間，較小的店家表現更差。

vocab.usage: bleed talent / cash 流失人才／現金；the company is bleeding money 公司正在大量虧錢
vocab.example: The startup was bleeding cash and had to cut staff.
vocab.example_zh: 這家新創正在大量燒錢，不得不裁員。

vocab.usage: a stellar performance / record 出色的表現／紀錄；doesn’t look stellar 看起來並不出色
vocab.example: She has a stellar record of meeting her sales targets.
vocab.example_zh: 她達成銷售目標的紀錄相當出色。

vocab.usage: a smaller operating loss 較小的營業虧損；report an operating loss 公布營業虧損（相對詞是 operating profit 營業利益）
vocab.example: The airline reported a smaller operating loss than analysts expected.
vocab.example_zh: 這家航空公司公布的營業虧損比分析師預期的更小。

vocab.usage: a compelling reason / case / story 令人信服的理由／論述／故事
vocab.example: He made a compelling case for changing the policy.
vocab.example_zh: 他提出了令人信服的理由，主張改變這項政策。

vocab.usage: gain / lose / take market share 提升／失去／搶下市占率
vocab.example: The brand increased its market share by offering lower prices.
vocab.example_zh: 這個品牌靠較低的價格提高了市占率。

vocab.usage: move with urgency 抓緊時間行動；a sense of urgency 急迫感
vocab.example: The storm gave the repairs a new sense of urgency.
vocab.example_zh: 暴風雨讓維修工作變得更急迫。

vocab.usage: after a brief / 11-day hiatus 在短暫／11 天的暫停之後；on hiatus 暫時停歇
vocab.example: The show returned to TV after a two-year hiatus.
vocab.example_zh: 這部影集在停播兩年後重返電視。

vocab.zh: 一百八十度轉變；突然轉向
vocab.usage: a stunning about-face 驚人的態度大轉彎；do an about-face 突然改變立場
vocab.example: The mayor did an about-face and supported the project.
vocab.example_zh: 市長突然一百八十度轉變，改為支持這個計畫。

vocab.usage: shares / prices skyrocketed 股價／價格飆升；skyrocketing costs 急遽上升的成本
vocab.example: Ticket prices skyrocketed after the team won the championship.
vocab.example_zh: 球隊奪冠後，門票價格飆升。

vocab.zh: 沒有負擔的；不受牽絆的
vocab.usage: unencumbered by debt / rules 不受債務／規定拖累；an unencumbered asset 無負擔資產
vocab.example: The new team was unencumbered by old contracts.
vocab.example_zh: 新團隊不受舊合約的束縛。
